subject: HEBR
title: Intermediate Modern Hebrew II
info: 5 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: HEBR 403 or equivalent.

sections.sectionText: A review of the fundamentals of Hebrew grammar, reading, writing, listening and speaking. Additional information: Must have completed HEBR206; or have the appropriate score on the World Language Placement (WLP); or students who have taken courses with comparable content may contact the department. This section is offered through the BTAA Course Share Program and will be taught via video-conferencing/Zoom/online by University of Maryland.
